title: Yara and the Cover
author: Paloma Sandoval
blurb: Vesper Amberdale, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, has spent ten years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the summit convenes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
